Thanks team — great turnout this morning. Quick summary + asks: we had 1,124 registrants, ~420 attendees, and ~85 accounts with multiple attendees. I exported a compact attendee sheet and a heatmap of account engagement (attached).

Key asks:
- SDR claim window: please claim hot accounts (see column H: 'Interest') within 48 hours.
- High-touch: any account with >=3 attendees OR demo request = HIGH.
- POC candidates: flagged in column F.

Ben/Marissa: can you split the hot list and confirm ownership by EOD Monday? I suggest the following quick buckets to populate in HubSpot: Hot (immediate outreach), Engage (schedule intro/demo), Nurture (replay + content). I've included a replay shortlink below for direct shares.

Replay: https://redwood.ai/replay/serving-llms-scale (short link also attached).

Attachments:
- attendee_list_oct03.csv (CSV: account, attendees, job titles, interest_score)
- engagement_heatmap_oct03.png (visual bucket by account)
- replay_shortlink.txt

I'll send a mutual action plan draft to share with high-touch accounts after ownership is confirmed.

Thanks — Hannah
